h: Xabi Alonso explains what went wrong as Chelsea lose to Tottenham
p: Chelsea were beaten by Tottenham in the London derby, and manager Xabi Alonso has spoken about where his side fell short. Fans online have been debating the result and the team's form. The defeat comes on a weekend when rivals picked up points.
more: Alonso pointed to key moments in the match that went against his team.
The loss has reignited talk about Chelsea's season so far.
